outlig*.sdf: SDF files with ligand poses. Multiple poses of the same ligand, never different ligands.
outlig*_ph4overlap.sdf: The docked ligands in SDF format with pharmacophore overlap score
rdock-grid.as: AS file. The cavity used for docking. You can pass it to acedock to save some time.
scores.csv: CSV file with a summary of the scores of the poses.
